commands: echo "GITHUB_ACTIONS=$GITHUB_ACTIONS"; echo "RUN_ID=$GITHUB_RUN_ID"; echo "ATTEMPT=$GITHUB_RUN_ATTEMPT"; echo "REPO=$GITHUB_REPOSITORY"; git branch --show-current; git status --short | head

DEVFLOW_ROOT="$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null || pwd)"
mkdir -p "$DEVFLOW_ROOT/.prflow/tmp/issue-body"
gh issue view 1253 --json body --jq '.body' > "$DEVFLOW_ROOT/.prflow/tmp/issue-body/issue-1253.md"
wc -l "$DEVFLOW_ROOT/.prflow/tmp/issue-body/issue-1253.md"
head -c 60 "$DEVFLOW_ROOT/.prflow/tmp/issue-body/issue-1253.md"; echo

mkdir -p .prflow/tmp/issue-body
gh issue view 1253 --json body --jq .body > .prflow/tmp/issue-body/issue-1253.md
wc -l .prflow/tmp/issue-body/issue-1253.md
date +%s; lib/test/run-shard.sh monolith > .prflow/tmp/mono.log 2>&1; echo "exit=$?"; date +%s; tail -5 .prflow/tmp/mono.log
S=$(date +%s); lib/test/run-shard.sh monolith 2>&1 | tail -25; E=$(date +%s); echo "MONOLITH_SECONDS=$((E-S))"

.prflow/vendor/prflow/scripts/workpad.py update 1253 \
  --status Reviewing \
  --tick-progress "code + sweeps" \
  --note "batched-regeneration: run (all artifacts reconciled, exit 0)" \
  --note "AC11: no changeset — diff confined to prompt-extensions, CLAUDE.md, docs, and a lib/test test-infra comment (all internal-only; not shipped engine surface)" \
  --replace-plan-file /dev/stdin <<'EOF' || .prflow/vendor/prflow/scripts/workpad.py update 1253 --status Reviewing
EOF
echo done
for sub in descriptor claim mark-running finish; do echo "=== $sub ==="; .prflow/vendor/prflow/scripts/verification-flight.py $sub --help 2>&1 | grep -A40 "options:" | head -40; done

scrub.shapes: GitHub tokens/PATs, Anthropic keys, Bearer Authorization headers, and basic Authorization headers
